Hi Aisha —

Great to meet you today — glad the demo was useful. Quick recap and concrete next steps below.

Recap:
- Redwood is SOC 2 Type 2 (most recent audit completed Q4 2026).
- We support SAML 2.0 for SSO and full SCIM v2 provisioning for user sync.
- RBAC: role-based permissions with built-in admin/observer roles and support for custom roles. All admin actions are logged and available in audit exports.

Action items / next steps:
1) I'll share our SOC 2 report and a short SCIM provisioning guide today (we'll redact any client-specific data).
2) Dev (cc'd) will provide the SAML metadata snippet and recommended assertion attributes for Aurora's IdP.
3) Aditya will coordinate the procurement/contract timeline and answer any licensing questions.
4) If you prefer, send over the top 10 rows of your vendor questionnaire and we'll populate the answers — otherwise we'll upload docs to the HubSpot deal and share a link.

Planned delivery: SOC 2 + SCIM guide + SAML snippet by end of day tomorrow (Tue).

Best,
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference

Marissa —

Attached: rbac-admin-controls.xlsx and audit-exports-sample.csv (redacted).
A few quick points:
- Admin actions (role changes, key rotations, login events) are stored for 12 months by default; extended retention options available as an add-on.
- RBAC: built-in roles = Owner, Admin, Developer, Observer. Customers can create custom roles scoped to models/routes.
- We log the acting_user, action_type, target_resource, timestamp, and request_id (helps correlate with traces).

I'll hand off the files to you for the customer packet.

Ethan
